/bin/bash -lc "cat > work/locate.py <<'PY'
import struct,gzip,numpy as np,json
f=open('work/hg38.2bit','rb')
sig=f.read(4)
endian='>' if struct.unpack('>I',sig)[0]==0x1a412743 else '<'
def u():return struct.unpack(endian+'I',f.read(4))[0]
version,nseq,res=u(),u(),u()
index={}
for i in range(nseq):
 n=f.read(1)[0];name=f.read(n).decode();index[name]=u()
lookup=np.array([''.join('TCAG'[(b>>s)&3] for s in [6,4,2,0]) for b in range(256)],dtype='S4')
with gzip.open('phase.chain.q1.R1.fq.gz','rt') as g:next(g);seq=next(g).strip()
rc=seq.translate(str.maketrans('ACGT','TGCA'))[::-1]
queries=[(strand,i,s[i:i+40].encode()) for strand,s in [('+',seq),('-',rc)] for i in [0,50,100]]
hits=[]
for name,offset in index.items():
 f.seek(offset);n=u();nb=u();ns=[u() for _ in range(nb)];nl=[u() for _ in range(nb)];mb=u();f.seek(8*mb+4,1)
 s=lookup[np.frombuffer(f.read((n+3)//4),dtype=np.uint8)].tobytes()[:n]
 for strand,i,q in queries:
  pos=s.find(q)
  while pos>=0:
   print(name,strand,i,pos,flush=True);hits.append([name,strand,i,pos])
   start=max(0,pos-3000);end=min(n,pos+3000)
   out=s[start:end].decode()
   with open('work/region.fa','w') as o:o.write('>'+name+':'+str(start)+'-'+str(end)+'\\n'+out+'\\n')
   pos=s.find(q,pos+1)
 if hits: break
 print('Scanned',name,n,flush=True)
json.dump(hits,open('work/locations.json','w'))
PY"
